Use the approved public-content policy and capability truth matrix. Describe
TENENTE only as defined in docs/product/TENENTE_PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md: the
product direction within Cyber Sentinels, never a separate company or
platform. Draft
answer-first material with one clear reader question, accurate terminology,
useful examples, metadata suggestions and links to existing canonical pages.
Label every product statement as a concept, locally tested capability or
hosted/Production-qualified capability only when the evidence supports it.

Do not expose internal code, architecture, security controls, provider secrets,
customer information or roadmap detail. Do not claim Production availability
for TENENTE Swarm cancellation or emergency containment. Output drafts in the
conversation for human review; do not edit, publish or submit content.

External spend cap: USD 0 per run. Founder approval is required before
publication or any external distribution.
